form:FormGroup.label: Path
form:FormGroup.helpText: Path to the shared file store. Note: This cannot be modified after data has been written.

form:FormGroup.label: Shard Count
form:FormGroup.helpText: The number of shards to partition the data across. Use 1 for no sharding. Note: This cannot be modified after data has been written.

form:FormGroup.label: Frequency
form:FormGroup.helpText: How often to look for data old enough to archive. This is the schedule, not the policy: the minimum archive age below decides which data moves, this decides how often we check. Data can stay in the main store for up to the minimum archive age plus this interval. Checking more often than the bucket granularity gains nothing.

form:FormGroup.label: Archive Data Older Than
form:FormGroup.helpText: Data older than this period becomes eligible for archiving. Must be less than the retention duration.

form:FormGroup.label: Bucket Granularity
form:FormGroup.helpText: How archive shards are time-bucketed: Hour, Day, or Week.
